# FLX-2109: no applied run at this run id

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim verify` and `fluxsim ship` read a run directory `fluxsim apply` wrote: the receipt and the run digest are the artifacts they check. Neither is present at this run id in this state directory, so there is nothing to verify or ship. Run `fluxsim apply` (or `fluxsim run`) first, then pass the run id it reports. A run directory that holds only shares (`fluxsim apply --shard I/N` writes `shard-I-of-N.json` and the shares' streams, and no receipt) is this case too: a share is part of a run, not a run, so apply the run whole, without --shard, before verifying or shipping it. A receipt that is present but cannot be read as the JSON object `fluxsim apply` wrote (truncated, not UTF-8 text, or not an object) is this case too: the directory holds no completed run, so delete it and run `fluxsim plan` and `fluxsim apply` again.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2109
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
